requirements.text: * 5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience building, supporting, and operating data pipelines and data platforms
* Azure Databricks experience, including pipeline development, job monitoring, workload support, performance tuning, and cost\-aware development practices
* Azure Data Factory experience with pipeline orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, monitoring, and operational support
* PySpark experience for distributed data processing, transformations, data quality validation, and performance tuning
* Git experience including CI/CD basics, version control, pull request workflows, branching strategies, and release support
* Experience supporting performance tuning and cost optimization activities for cloud data pipelines, Databricks workloads, and distributed processing jobs
* Basic working understanding of data governance, data security, access controls, privacy, and enterprise compliance concepts
* Baseline proficiency with enterprise\-approved AI tools including GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Databricks Genie, and other approved GenAI platforms
* Proficiency in Python for programming, automation, data processing, and scripting
* Proven good problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot data pipeline issues, and follow reliable engineering practices
* Proven good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to share technical updates, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress clearly

* Use or support custom agents for pipeline development, automated test creation, data quality validation, failure detection, incident triage, runbook execution, and operational reporting while staying current with evolving AI capabilities, features, and enterprise guidance

* Prior experience building Identity data pipelines, identity resolution pipelines, consumer profile data pipelines, member/customer identity management solutions, or similar identity\-matching and entity\-resolution capabilities
* Hands\-on experience building, configuring, or supporting custom AI agents to assist with development, testing, documentation, data validation, monitoring, and data workflow execution
* Hands\-on experience using Databricks Genie and GitHub Copilot for pipeline development, debugging, documentation, automation, and development productivity improvements
* Data engineering experience with Python, PySpark, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Git in a cloud data platform environment
* Healthcare, insurance, consumer profile, or enterprise identity data experience is preferred
